probeContract.purpose: Revalidate robots and public-use conditions before any KODEX product metadata request

decision.reason: robots rules and public-use conditions are not observable because both policy entrypoints return HTTP 429; prior product-detail probes also returned 429

resumeConditions: The issuer provides an accessible robots.txt and public-use terms contract that permits the intended local-only collection.
The issuer provides a documented public product metadata API or explicit collection permission.
A later low-volume recheck returns ordinary public responses without requiring challenge bypass.
prohibitedNextSteps: Do not solve or bypass the Cloudflare challenge.
Do not rotate identities, cookies, user agents, proxies, or IP addresses.
